title: Replication package: project-declared and learned blame ignore lists and line-based ownership
description: Replication package for a census of 435 GitHub repositories with at least 5,000 stars that keep a .git-blame-ignore-revs file. It contains the sampling frame, the measurement and analysis scripts, the per-repository measurement records with hashed developer identities, and the script that regenerates every number, table, and figure of the article. Version 2.0.0 adds a detector trained on the project declarations that recommends which commits blame should ignore, its protocol and decision log, the recorded runs of its development and its one-time final evaluation on 162 held-out repositories, and its application to 150 popular repositories that declare nothing.
